text:
Ellen (Engineering): Quick policy check: I used personal miles to upgrade to premium economy LHR->SFO to avoid jetlag. Can I expense the upgrade cost or airline taxes?

Sam (People Ops): Upgrades bought with personal funds or miles are generally not reimbursable unless preapproved for medical reasons or customer-facing exec travel.

Marco - Finance: Taxes/airport surcharges tied to the upgrade (e.g., carrier-imposed fees) are reimbursable if you have a line item receipt showing the charge. Attach the fare breakdown.

Ellen (Engineering): Got it. Also traveling with my partner who extends the trip by 3 days. We booked one hotel for the whole stay. How do I separate business nights?

Tracey (Manager): Only business nights are reimbursable. Ask the hotel for an itemized folio split by dates or provide two receipts. If impossible, submit the full folio plus a manager attestation and show which nights were personal.

Ellen (Engineering): I also have a travel credit from a cancelled leg. If I apply the voucher to my return that includes business nights, how does that affect reimbursement?

Marco - Finance: Travel credits used toward business travel reduce the reimbursable amount. Include voucher ID and calculation showing net out-of-pocket. Finance will net it when processing.

Ellen (Engineering): One more: I paid a voluntary carbon offset at checkout (~$28). Is that reimbursable?

Sam (People Ops): Up to $30 per roundtrip is allowed with preapproval under our sustainability perk. Attach the offset receipt and note it on the expense. Over $30 needs manager sign-off.

CardDeclineBot: If company card declines and you pay personally, attach the failed auth screenshot and the personal receipt for reimbursement.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: file Travel Preapproval before booking: https://redwood.company/travel-preapproval. Required: itinerary, expected upgrades, companion notes, and any vouchers or sustainability receipts. Missing preapproval can delay reimbursements. :airplane:

Ellen (Engineering): Thanks all 60a I'll request preapproval for the carbon offset and upload the hotel folio split request.
